note: Complete public scientific-checker bank. Inactive unless SCIBENCH_TRIGGER_LOG is set. Historical quality-review metadata does not remove checker IDs from the agent-visible task.

checkers.alarm: Condition-aware round-trip error exceeds a participating-dtype operation bound.
checkers.invariant: N/E to R/T and back through rotate_rt_ne recovers both components.
checkers.precondition: Equal-length finite floating N/E arrays, back-azimuth in [0,360], and bounded dynamic range.
checkers.rationale: A failed inverse changes inferred radial and transverse motion.

checkers.alarm: R/T and N/E squared norms differ beyond accumulated participating-dtype error.
checkers.invariant: An orthonormal N/E to R/T basis change preserves per-sample squared norm.
checkers.precondition: OB-ROT-001 domain with squared norms representable in the working dtype.
checkers.rationale: Coordinate rotation cannot create or destroy ground-motion amplitude.

checkers.alarm: Any reconstructed component exceeds its participating-dtype operation bound.
checkers.invariant: ZNE to LQT and back through rotate_lqt_zne recovers all components.
checkers.precondition: Equal-length finite Z/N/E arrays, angles in [0,360], and bounded dynamic range.
checkers.rationale: Ray-coordinate polarization requires a faithful basis transformation.

checkers.alarm: ZNE and LQT squared norms differ beyond accumulated participating-dtype error.
checkers.invariant: The orthonormal ZNE/LQT transform preserves per-sample squared norm.
checkers.precondition: OB-ROT-003 domain with squared norms representable in the working dtype.
checkers.rationale: A coordinate transform cannot change physical ground-motion amplitude.

checkers.alarm: Round-trip error exceeds eps times orientation condition and signal scale.
checkers.invariant: Sensor components to ZNE and back to the same sensor basis recovers all records.
checkers.precondition: Finite equal-length channels and a nonsingular orientation matrix with condition number <=1e8.
checkers.rationale: SEED orientation metadata must define a reversible physical basis.

checkers.alarm: A permuted public-API call differs beyond the conditioning-aware bound.
checkers.invariant: Jointly permuting channel data and their orientation metadata leaves ZNE unchanged.
checkers.precondition: OB-ROT-005 domain.
checkers.rationale: Station channel ordering has no physical meaning when metadata follows it.

checkers.alarm: Permuted-call physical outputs exceed a least-squares conditioning bound.
checkers.invariant: Joint station permutation preserves recovered strain and rotation time series.
checkers.observation_point: After the result dictionary is assembled.
checkers.precondition: Finite nondegenerate array geometry, positive vp>vs, positive noise, and normal-matrix condition <=1e7.
checkers.rationale: Station labels cannot affect inferred Earth strain or rotation.

checkers.alarm: Translated-call outputs exceed coordinate-dtype cancellation and least-squares error.
checkers.invariant: A common translation of all station coordinates leaves strain and rotation unchanged.
checkers.observation_point: After the result dictionary is assembled.
checkers.precondition: OB-ARR-001 domain and a dtype-preserving translation whose rounding is small relative to array aperture.
checkers.rationale: Spatial gradients depend on station separation, not coordinate origin.

checkers.alarm: Common-mode transformed outputs exceed differencing and solve error.
checkers.invariant: Adding identical three-component motion at every station leaves strain and rotation unchanged.
checkers.observation_point: After the result dictionary is assembled.
checkers.precondition: OB-ARR-001 domain and finite representable common motion.
checkers.rationale: Rigid translation of the full array has no spatial gradient.

checkers.alarm: The transverse displacement residual exceeds tensor-contraction error.
checkers.invariant: P-wave far-field displacement is parallel to the radial direction.
checkers.precondition: Finite symmetric moment tensor and finite nonzero observation vectors.
checkers.rationale: P-wave radiation is longitudinal.

checkers.alarm: The radial projection exceeds tensor-contraction error.
checkers.invariant: S-wave far-field displacement is orthogonal to the radial direction.
checkers.precondition: Finite symmetric moment tensor and finite nonzero observation vectors.
checkers.rationale: S-wave radiation is transverse.

checkers.alarm: Cartesian public-API re-call differs beyond conversion and contraction error.
checkers.invariant: Angular and Cartesian representations of the same directions yield the same displacement.
checkers.observation_point: After a farfield call with angular input.
checkers.precondition: Finite angular directions and moment tensor with representable trigonometric conversion.
checkers.rationale: Radiation cannot depend on a supported direction representation.

checkers.alarm: farfield(M,-p)+farfield(M,p) exceeds tensor-contraction error.
checkers.invariant: Radiation at an antipodal direction is the negative of the original displacement.
checkers.precondition: Finite moment tensor and finite nonzero Cartesian directions whose negation is representable in the input dtype.
checkers.rationale: Moment-tensor far-field displacement has odd antipodal parity.

checkers.alarm: The transformed re-call disagrees with the rotated original result.
checkers.invariant: Rotating tensor and directions rotates, but otherwise preserves, displacement.
checkers.precondition: Finite tensor and directions; exact signed-permutation orthogonal transform.
checkers.rationale: A radiation pattern is independent of arbitrary Cartesian axis labels.

checkers.alarm: Scaled public-API call changes azimuth, incidence, rectilinearity, or planarity beyond eigensolver error.
checkers.invariant: Uniform amplitude/unit scaling preserves all polarization attributes.
checkers.precondition: Finite nondegenerate ZNE covariance, >=3 selected samples, and threshold scaled with amplitude squared.
checkers.rationale: Polarization geometry is independent of amplitude units.

checkers.alarm: The rotated-frame public-API call violates angular covariance or scalar invariance.
checkers.invariant: An exact 90-degree N/E frame rotation shifts azimuth modulo 180 and preserves other attributes.
checkers.precondition: OB-POL-001 domain with separated covariance eigenvalues; azimuth is compared only for a non-vertical principal axis.
checkers.rationale: Polarization must covary with the geographic coordinate frame.
checkers.scientific_quantity: polarization direction in a horizontal frame

checkers.alarm: The polarity-reversed public-API call changes the canonicalized output.
checkers.invariant: Reversing all component polarities preserves canonical polarization attributes.
checkers.precondition: OB-POL-001 domain with separated covariance eigenvalues.
checkers.rationale: Covariance polarization identifies an axis rather than an arrow.

checkers.alarm: The transformed public-API output differs beyond covariance/SVD error (eigenvalues scaled by the largest eigenvalue).
checkers.invariant: An exact signed permutation of component axes preserves eigenvalues and dimensionless polarization measures.
checkers.precondition: Finite equal-shaped component windows, positive normf, and representable covariance.
checkers.rationale: Polarization eigenvalues are coordinate invariants.

checkers.alarm: The scaled-call covariance or dimensionless relations exceed numerical error.
checkers.invariant: Scaling components by c scales eigenvalue quantities by c^2 and preserves rectilinearity/planarity.
checkers.precondition: OB-POL-004 domain and bounded positive scale factor.
checkers.rationale: Changing displacement units cannot change dimensionless polarization shape.
checkers.scientific_quantity: polarization covariance and shape under unit scaling

checkers.alarm: A branch cannot be matched or differs beyond requested ray interpolation tolerance.
checkers.invariant: Travel-time and ray-path APIs return the same branches, times, and ray parameters.
checkers.precondition: Valid model depths, distance, explicit phase list, and finite returned branches.
checkers.rationale: Path and scalar products represent the same seismic rays.
checkers.scientific_quantity: seismic arrival branch time and ray parameter

checkers.alarm: Branch matching or values differ beyond requested interpolation tolerance.
checkers.invariant: Travel-time and pierce-point APIs return the same branches, times, and ray parameters.
checkers.precondition: OB-TAUP-001 domain.
checkers.rationale: Adding discontinuity crossings must not alter the underlying ray solution.
checkers.scientific_quantity: seismic arrival branch and discontinuity crossings

checkers.alarm: Endpoint disagreement exceeds the largest of 256 times requested ray-parameter refinement, float error, and 0.2% of the arrival time or distance.
checkers.invariant: Final path time and angular distance agree with arrival time and purist distance.
checkers.precondition: Finite nonempty, non-resampled path and finite arrival metadata.
checkers.rationale: A ray path must terminate at its reported receiver in time and angle.

checkers.alarm: Python result has a different shape or differs beyond eps times trace length, output scale and cumulative-to-window energy ratio.
checkers.invariant: Independent C and Python implementations agree within cumulative-sum error.
checkers.precondition: Finite float64 trace, nlta>nsta>0, sufficient samples, and representable energy.
checkers.rationale: Implementation choice must not change seismic onset strength.

checkers.alarm: Python result differs beyond a length- and scale-aware recurrence bound.
checkers.invariant: Independent C and Python recursive implementations agree within accumulation error.
checkers.precondition: Finite float64 trace, nlta>nsta>0, sufficient samples, and representable recurrence.
checkers.rationale: Implementation choice must not change seismic onset strength.

checkers.alarm: Any of up to 33 sampled bins disagrees beyond its condition- and degree-aware polynomial/product evaluation error.
checkers.invariant: Vectorized SciPy response amplitudes agree with ObsPy's scalar PAZ evaluator at sampled FFT frequencies.
checkers.precondition: Finite stable conjugate PAZ, positive sampling interval/FFT length, and sampled polynomial-evaluation condition <=1e8.
checkers.rationale: Instrument correction requires a consistent transfer function across independent paths.

checkers.alarm: Reverse-direction distance differs beyond an ellipsoid-scale float bound.
checkers.invariant: Exchanging endpoints preserves geodesic distance.
checkers.observation_point: After the inverse geodesic solution returns.
checkers.precondition: Distinct finite geographic points, valid positive ellipsoid, and a solved non-antipodal geodesic.
checkers.rationale: Physical surface distance is independent of travel direction.

checkers.alarm: Either reciprocal bearing has excessive circular disagreement.
checkers.invariant: Exchanging endpoints exchanges forward and back azimuths modulo 360 degrees.
checkers.precondition: OB-GEO-001 domain with distinct endpoints.
checkers.rationale: Reversing a geodesic exchanges its endpoint bearings.

checkers.alarm: Distance or circular bearings differ beyond condition-aware rounding error.
checkers.invariant: Adding a full turn to both longitudes preserves distance and bearings.
checkers.precondition: OB-GEO-001 domain with moderate longitudes and bearing condition <=1e8 away from coincident and antipodal singularities.
checkers.rationale: A geodesic cannot depend on longitude representation.

checkers.alarm: Reverse-direction result differs beyond trigonometric rounding error.
checkers.invariant: Exchanging endpoints preserves angular distance.
checkers.precondition: Finite broadcast-compatible geographic points with valid latitudes and moderate longitudes.
checkers.rationale: Spherical surface distance has no preferred direction.

checkers.alarm: The distances differ beyond trigonometric rounding error.
checkers.invariant: A common 90-degree longitude rotation preserves angular distance.
checkers.precondition: OB-GEO-004 domain.
checkers.rationale: Great-circle separation is independent of the prime meridian.

checkers.alarm: Metric and converted angular distances exceed combined model rounding error.
checkers.invariant: A zero-flattening ellipsoid agrees with spherical angular distance using the same radius.
checkers.precondition: Solved finite non-antipodal points and a positive finite sphere radius.
checkers.rationale: A zero-flattening ellipsoid is physically the same sphere.

checkers.alarm: Shifted mean disagrees with the rotated original beyond sample-conditioned error.
checkers.invariant: A common longitude rotation rotates the circular mean modulo 360 degrees.
checkers.observation_point: After the circular mean is returned.
checkers.precondition: Finite nonempty longitudes in [-180,180] with nondegenerate circular resultant.
checkers.rationale: Mean direction must covary with the longitude reference frame.

checkers.alarm: Exchanged correlation differs from the reversed result beyond accumulation error.
checkers.invariant: Exchanging waveforms reverses the lag axis.
checkers.precondition: Equal-length finite floating waveforms, valid shift, and nonzero energy when normalized.
checkers.rationale: Inferred delay changes sign when waveform roles exchange.

checkers.alarm: Normalized coefficients differ beyond norm and dot-product rounding error.
checkers.invariant: Positive waveform gain changes do not alter normalized correlation.
checkers.precondition: OB-XCORR-001 domain with naive normalization and bounded positive rescaling.
checkers.rationale: Normalized waveform similarity measures shape, not sensor gain.

checkers.alarm: The algorithms disagree beyond their combined length-scaled error.
checkers.invariant: Direct summation and FFT convolution return the same normalized correlation.
checkers.observation_point: Results from both supported numerical methods.
checkers.precondition: OB-XCORR-001 domain with real floating waveforms and meaningful energy.
checkers.rationale: Waveform similarity and delay cannot depend on the numerical backend.
